'''Laroon wood''' was a rare type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]] used primarily in luxury settings. [[Meeting Room A3000291]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] was paneled with laroon wood.
